caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a square, slightly rounded top surface that features smooth, curved edges. The table is a light brown color, indicating a natural wood finish. It has a central, ornately turned pedestal with circular and bulbous decorations in the middle section, leading down to a cylindrical base. From the base, three splayed, curved legs extend outwards and down to provide support. The background is plain and beige, without any additional objects or embellishments, focusing attention solely on the detailed depiction of the table itself.
